PostSummary: Former pastors and ministry leaders post tell-all videos about why they left ministry or faith, and their insider status gives their criticisms unusual weight with viewers.
BiblicalResponse: Listen with both compassion and discernment. A person's story is their own, and ministry wounds are real — but one person's experience, however sincere, is not a verdict on the truth of Christianity. Weigh what is said against Scripture, remember that leaders are fallible people under unique pressure, and resist building your faith — or your unbelief — on someone else's biography.
